title: Remove PDF Exports from pre-login page feature list

requirements.summary: Remove the 'PDF Exports' list item from the pre-login page feature list
acceptanceCriteria: The 'PDF Exports' list item is no longer rendered in the specified section of the pre-login/login page.
All other list items in that section remain unchanged.
No visual regressions are introduced on the login page.

file_operations.description: Remove the 'PDF Exports' list item (the third <li> element) from the features list in the LoginPage component. This list item contains the export-icon image and the text 'PDF Exports'. Keep all other list items (CSV Exports, Multiple Scenarios, and Built-in Usage Guide) unchanged. Ensure the visual layout and styling remain consistent after removal.
